name: Critical Thinking
vision_statement: The AI checks its work against what success means for the person.
opportunities: A deep run can be held to the metric that serves its goal, and so can every other request, which is wider than the parent solution asks. That opens questions of its own: slicing the specification a task concerns before the run and writing back what the run learned, choosing the records an input concerns by lexical, vector and gated search, settling a narrow question with one guarded model call and a safe default, stopping unverified links and recognising repeated requests, telling a stuck run from a slow one, drafting a metric for a task that has none, and keeping background work to the days, hours and budget a person set.
solution_coherence: Critical Thinking holds a request to a measure. Metric Translation turns the request into a metric with a target. ESOI Application finds the specifications the request concerns and works to them. Goal Completion judges whether the goal was met and not merely claimed. Response Quality guards what a reply says against what is known.
